evidence: The PR's screen_cudagraph_wins.py from its head, unmodified, run fresh on the candidate arm twice (script-c53-boot1/2.json). Image A/B (harness ab960.py, ABBA base/c53/c53/base, same session): the same 23-group DeepseekV41B12xMetadataBuilder + CEDState workload and shapes as the script's section 1, each image on the path its own code takes on a FULL decode step: base = build_slot_mappings_by_layer + CEDState.stage + 23 builder.build() + replay; candidate = CEDState.stage_floors + replay of the graph holding CEDState.prepare_cudagraph_replay and the 23 builders' prepare_cudagraph_replay. Two timers: wall (host+device per step, 300 back-to-back steps, 7 windows after 100 warm-up steps; the script's method) and device time with the host hidden (a 1.17 ms sleep kernel queued first; every step's host enqueue, max 0.62 ms, finished before it ended). Digest of all metadata buffers after the step, compared across images.
The PR's tests on the candidate arm, twice: tests/v1/attention/test_b12x_v41_ced_metadata.py and tests/v1/cudagraph/test_cudagraph_manager.py with the release bundle's tblib_stub plugin.

measured.pr_script_note: Reproduces the PR's section 1 (438-456 us -> 31-40 us, bit_exact True on all 9 shapes, both boots). Its other sections are not this patch: the MoE post-gate fork section times hand-written stream schedules (the head dropped the fork from the patch; recorded bit_exact True, no claim taken); the DFlash padding_rows section times a Python loop that skips the launch (12.7-14.3 us -> 0.04 us); the lead-chunk section is the PR's dead end.
measured.image_ab_summary: All 9 shapes: wall 467-484 us (base) -> 30.9-40.0 us (candidate), -91.7% to -93.3%, Welch 95% interval of the change about -435 to -444 us, verdict better; device time with the host hidden 51.7-82.3 us -> 32.6-41.7 us (-43% to -56%), better: the in-graph metadata does not add device time, it removes the eager launches' gaps. With floors changing every step (stage_floors then copies) the candidate is 37-50 us wall, 39.7-47.8 us device, still better on every shape.
measured.bit_exact: In the candidate image the graph path's metadata digest equals the eager path's on all 9 shapes, both boots; and it equals the base image's eager digest on all 9 shapes (all four boots give one digest per shape).

eager_path_cross_image.note: The eager path (non-FULL steps), whose CEDState.stage the patch moved to a 4-slot pinned ring: 8 of 9 shapes same, 1 flagged (3,18) +0.6% (+2.2 us of 475 us); mean over shapes +0.1%. Not the path a FULL decode step takes.

notes: The PR's README still describes the MoE post-gate fork and a stage_cudagraph_replay hook; the head patch has neither (model_state.stage_full_cudagraph_attn, the ring-buffered CEDState.stage and stage_floors are what it adds). The fast path is gated on the speculator's uses_target_attn_metadata being False: DSparkSpeculator inherits False from DFlashSpeculator, so the recipe's DSpark takes it.

The PR's in-process baseline adds two hand-made pinned tensors on top of CEDState.stage's own two (eager_pr in ab960); the image A/B's base path leaves them out. They cost about 4-9 us; the change is the same either way.

script-c53-boot1 ran with the first warm.py (its warm-up was one GEMM including cuBLAS init); script-c53-boot2 and all A/B runs ran with the fixed one. The script is an in-process comparison with its own 30+10-step warm-ups; its two boots agree within 1-3%.
